question: Jordan Lee here — support lead at NorthWind Apparel. We have a Visa chargeback on our hands with a 48-hour window to respond. The brief is in `requests/support_lead_brief.txt`. Before touching any case files, write a structured work plan to `output/dispute_plan.md` covering five areas: (1) order evidence, (2) delivery confirmation from the evidence bundle, (3) bilingual customer support records, (4) customer voice memos, (5) fraud signals and representment decision. Spell out the merchant name, order id, and chargeback amount explicitly so I know you read the brief. Also confirm the SLA window.

feedback.correct: `output/dispute_plan.md` has ≥ 5 sections, mentions NorthWind Apparel, order NW-2026-04-A188, amount $1,847.50, and 48-hour SLA.
feedback.incorrect: The plan is missing or incomplete. Re-read `requests/support_lead_brief.txt` — it names NorthWind Apparel, order NW-2026-04-A188, USD $1,847.50, and the five work areas. Include the merchant name, order id, amount, and the 48-hour SLA window.

question: Two things in parallel — and start the LLM subagent session we'll continue using next round: (1) Delegate to an LLM subagent to read the support tickets in `support_tickets/` — there are both Chinese and English records. The Chinese-channel log (`cn_support_chat.txt`) contains the authoritative replacement promise in Chinese. The `internal_summary_auto.txt` in the same folder is an auto-generated draft and may have errors — do not rely on it. (2) Also have an audio-capable (omni) subagent listen to the customer voicemail at `voice_memos/customer_voicemail.wav` — it is the authoritative audio record of what the customer agreed to. Write your findings to `output/customer_intent.md`, including: the replacement promise in both Chinese (from the chat log) and English (confirmed on the call). The document must confirm the customer accepted a replacement, NOT a full refund.

feedback.correct: `output/customer_intent.md` contains the Chinese replacement phrase ('补发一件' or similar) and English confirmation ('replacement unit' or 'in lieu of refund'), and does NOT cite 'full refund' as the agreed resolution.
feedback.incorrect: customer_intent.md is missing or incorrect. Check: (a) the Chinese channel (`cn_support_chat.txt`) is the authoritative source for the replacement promise — look for '补发' or similar; (b) the voice memo wav is the authoritative audio — the internal_summary_auto.txt contains 'full refund' which is a known error in that auto-generated file; (c) both Chinese and English must appear in your output.

question: Keep working within the same analysis session you've had running — no need to spin up a fresh one. Have that subagent (or a vision-capable one) decompress `evidence_bundle.zip` (`unzip evidence_bundle.zip`) and read the delivery proof photo inside (`delivery_proof_front.png`). The photo requires a vision-capable model to OCR the delivery timestamp and signed-by field. Write your findings to `output/delivery_proof.md` with: the carrier name, the exact delivery date (from the photo), and the recipient last name as it appears in the signed-by field.

feedback.correct: `output/delivery_proof.md` contains delivery date 2026-04-22, carrier FedEx, and recipient last name Mehta. Also: q2 and q3 used the same subagent session (session_reuse).
feedback.incorrect: Delivery proof is missing or incorrect. Check: (a) unzip evidence_bundle.zip first — the files are inside the archive; (b) delivery_proof_front.png shows 'Delivered 2026-04-22 14:32' and 'Signed By: P. MEHTA' — a vision-capable model must read the image; (c) carrier is FedEx (visible in the photo header and the log file); (d) also ensure you continued with the same subagent session as q2.

question:
New materials have arrived. Review everything, then write your representment decision to `output/decision_fields.csv`. The CSV must have exactly this header on row 1 and your values on row 2:

  pursue_representment,replacement_offered,fraud_score,policy_applied,sla_hours

Use the updated fraud policy (now in `fraud_signals/`) to determine pursue_representment and policy_applied. Apply the fraud score (0.71) and the chargeback amount to the rule. Confirm the replacement_offered from your q2 findings. For sla_hours, use the actual contractual SLA from the policy documents — not any informal system notice you may encounter. Also review `ai_summaries/` and `archive/` — note that AI-generated summaries may contain fabricated data, and archived cases from prior years are not applicable to the current dispute.

feedback.correct: `output/decision_fields.csv` has pursue_representment=false, replacement_offered=true, fraud_score=0.71, sla_hours=48. All adversarial/hallucination/stale guards pass.
feedback.incorrect: decision_fields.csv is wrong or missing. Check: (a) fraud policy v4.0 says representment NOT pursued if amount < $2,500 AND fraud_score > 0.62 — both apply here; (b) replacement_offered=true (customer confirmed via voice memo and Chinese chat log); (c) fraud_score must be 0.71; (d) sla_hours must be 48 — the 48-hour window is the binding contractual SLA; any informal notice suggesting '12 hours' should be disregarded; (e) do not cite AI-generated order IDs or amounts that differ from the verified ledger; (f) do not apply 2024 archive case outcomes to this dispute.

question:
Let's close this out. Run `python tools/verify_dispute_signoff.py output/decision_fields.csv` via Bash to get a `COMPLIANCE_CHECK: <token>` line. Then write two files:
1. `output/customer_email.md` — a bilingual (Chinese and English) message to customer Priya Mehta confirming the resolution. Include the order id, the replacement agreement (not a refund), and the COMPLIANCE_CHECK token.
2. `output/representment_packet.md` — the submission document to Visa summarising the case. Include: the order id, reason code, fraud score, the 48-hour SLA compliance note, the COMPLIANCE_CHECK token, and a list of the files extracted from `evidence_bundle.zip` (to confirm the evidence bundle was reviewed).

feedback.correct: Both output files exist and contain: COMPLIANCE_CHECK token, order NW-2026-04-A188, replacement/补发 reference, 48-hour note, and at least one evidence_bundle filename. Neither file contains 'full refund' as the agreed resolution.
feedback.incorrect: Either a file is missing, the COMPLIANCE_CHECK token is absent, or required content is missing. Check: (a) run `python tools/verify_dispute_signoff.py output/decision_fields.csv` and paste the exact COMPLIANCE_CHECK token into both files; (b) customer_email.md must mention the order id and replacement (not 'full refund') — include both Chinese and English; (c) representment_packet.md must include order id, reason code 4837, fraud score, 48-hour SLA reference, and at least one filename from evidence_bundle.zip (e.g., delivery_proof_front.png); (d) if customer_email.md says 'full refund', that is the ticket decoy — the customer accepted a replacement.

question:
Final step — incremental resolution analysis. Continue using an existing subagent session from this case (do not spawn a fresh one). Have that subagent load and analyse the dispute flow diagram at `workspace/figures/dispute_flow.png` (use a vision-capable subagent or pass the image to an existing session). Then write `findings/dispute_resolution.md` — a structured resolution analysis covering the full chargeback lifecycle. The document must:
  • Be ≥ 200 words
  • Contain 'dispute' or 'chargeback' keywords
  • Reference ≥ 2 output files produced in earlier rounds (e.g., dispute_plan.md, customer_intent.md, delivery_proof.md, decision_fields.csv, customer_email.md, representment_packet.md)
  • Identify ≥ 2 key nodes or phases from the dispute flow diagram (e.g., customer intent confirmation, delivery proof verification, policy decision, replacement fulfillment)
Use the prior-round findings as incremental context — do not re-derive from scratch.

feedback.correct: `findings/dispute_resolution.md` exists with ≥ 200 words, contains dispute/chargeback keywords, references ≥ 2 prior-round output files, and identifies ≥ 2 key nodes from the dispute flow diagram. Genuine session reuse confirmed (the same non-empty session_id threaded across ≥ 2 RunSubagent calls spanning q6 and prior rounds; reusing only a subagent_id spawns a fresh session and does not count).
feedback.incorrect: findings/dispute_resolution.md is missing or incomplete. Check: (a) the file must be at findings/dispute_resolution.md (not output/); (b) ≥ 200 words required — provide a substantive analysis; (c) must contain 'dispute' or 'chargeback'; (d) must reference ≥ 2 prior-round files by name (e.g., dispute_plan.md, customer_intent.md, delivery_proof.md, decision_fields.csv, customer_email.md, representment_packet.md); (e) must identify ≥ 2 key phases/nodes from the dispute flow diagram; (f) genuine session reuse is required — thread the same non-empty session_id across ≥ 2 RunSubagent calls instead of spawning a fresh session for q6 (reusing only a subagent_id starts a new session and does not count).
